Find your people.

Bible study groups and ministries for every season of life, with Scripture and community at the center. Most groups are 5 to 15 people, and many meet in homes.

Bible study groups
for every season.

From the first Sunday school song to a lifetime of friendship, there’s a place to grow at every stage.

  1. KidsUp to grade 4

    Children’s Sunday School

    While you worship, your kids are learning about Jesus. Bible stories, music, crafts and lessons made for their age, taught by our volunteer Sunday school teachers during the service.

    Sundays, during the 1:30 PM service

    Ask about this group
  2. YouthTeens

    Youth Ministry

    Led by Pastor Jaden Esquejo, our youth ministry is built on discipleship, not programs. Teens open the Bible together, ask honest questions, and learn how the gospel is lived out.

    Ask us for this season’s schedule

    Ask about this group
  3. Young adults18 and up

    Young Adult Bible Study

    Usually in someone’s home: catching up, a devotion, Bible study, then praying in small groups. For singles 18 and up who want to follow Jesus through the questions of this season of life.

    Usually in a home

    Ask about this group
  4. Young couplesMarried and engaged

    Young Couple Fellowship

    For married and engaged couples. Together we look at how biblical principles shape a marriage, and we encourage and pray for one another along the way.

    Ask us for the next gathering

    Ask about this group
  5. Men & womenEvery age

    Men’s Fellowship & Bible Study

    Men sharpening one another through the Word and in everyday life.

    Ask about this group

    Women’s Fellowship & Bible Study

    Women encouraging one another in the study of the Word and in everyday life.

    Ask about this group

    Both meet in Connect Groups, right after the Sunday service.

Wherever you are, start here.

Two gatherings open to everyone, whether you’re brand new to faith or have walked with Jesus for decades.

Exploring faith

Discovery Bible Study

New to faith, or want a refresher? Discovery is a Bible study for beginners that walks through the foundations of the Christian faith, from the grace of God to the assurance of salvation, through discussion in a small group.

Small groups, ask us for the next one

Ask about this group
Prayer

Wednesday Prayer Meeting

Led by Pastor Wendell Olojan. We pray for one another, our community and those who are sick, with a devotional to dig deeper into the Word.

Wednesdays at 7 PM, usually at 427 Matheson Avenue

Ask about this group

Sunday doesn’t end
at the benediction.

When the service ends, the conversation keeps going.

  1. 1:30 PM

    Worship and the Word

    We sing, pray and open the Bible together. Kids head to Sunday school during the service.

  2. After the service

    Connect Groups

    Our men’s and women’s groups meet, and some young adults stay for their own Bible study.

  3. Stay a while

    Time to talk

    There’s always time to catch up, and some afternoons end with a game of pickleball.

Not sure where you fit?

Tell us a little about your season of life, and we’ll help you find your people. Or come on Sunday and meet us in person.
